{{Quote|Oh, by the way, a former Imperial Navy lieutenant you had court-martialed is about to release a memoir. ''Into the Maw: Black Holes, Egos, and Other Forces that Devour Lives''. Guess who it's about.|Wynn Dorvan to Natasi Daala, on the memoir|<ref name="lash" />}}
'''''Into the Maw: Black Holes, Egos, and Other Forces that Devour Lives''''' was a memoir written by a former [[Unidentified Imperial Navy lieutenant|Imperial lieutenant]]. The ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Natasi Daala]], now [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]], had court-martialed the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], who had once served with the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The lieutenant wrote the memoir about Daala and planned to release it around [[44 ABY]], as public support for Daala began to decline.<ref name="lash" />

Shortly before the release of ''Into the Maw: Black Holes, Egos, and Other Forces that Devour Lives'', Daala's [[Aide/Legends|aide]], [[Wynn Dorvan]], learned of the planned memoir and informed her about it.<ref name="lash" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Into the Maw: Black Holes, Egos, and Other Forces that Devour Lives'' was first mentioned in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', the fourth novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, written by [[Aaron Allston]] and released [[March 9]], [[2010]].
